O.outcome_detail: perceived usefulness and limitations of AI tools for dyslexic learners

cells.quote: "The retrieved subgraphs from the KG suggests that dyslexic learners perceive existing AI tools as useful but still limited, indicating scope for further AI development in this area."
cells.note: The quoted sentence is from the wiki entry rather than the supplied study text. It reports an author interpretation from retrieved KG subgraphs, not a tested treatment-comparison; no effect size or test statistic is printed.
